stem: Quick check — Define resource dependencies in configuration (includes depends_on and create_before_destroy lifecycle). Which practice is correct?

choices.text: Ignore least privilege and use the root user for speed
Leave hourly resources running overnight without teardown
Treat budget alerts as a hard spend stop that deletes resources
Apply the objective directly: Define resource dependencies in configuration (includes depends_on and create_before_destroy lifecycle)

rationale: Correct: 'Apply the objective directly: Define resource dependencies in configuration (includes depends_on and create_before_destroy lifecycle)'. The other choices break root/MFA guidance, skip teardown, or misstate AWS Budgets behavior (alerts do not stop spend).
